mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.5% (FEDFUNDS < 4.5) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is the level of FEDFUNDS, and the direction is positive when the rate is below 4.5%.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS < 4.5, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% (FEDFUNDS > 5.0) signals a tightening monetary cycle that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 5.0, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is rising and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is above 207.5, it signals a tightening monetary cycle that compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS rise > 0.2% and CPIAUCSL > 207.5, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% per month), the S&P 500 is expected to have positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% per month)
failure_condition: In tight labor market conditions (UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% per month), the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 1300 (HOUST < 1300) signals a slowdown in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1300, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is falling and GDP (GDPC1) is falling, it signals an imminent recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO decline > 0.5% and GDPC1 decline > 0.2%, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A residential sales level above 380000 (RSAFS > 380000) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. The signal is the level of RSAFS, and the direction is positive when RSAFS is above 380000.
failure_condition: When RSAFS > 380000, the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 207.5 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the S&P 500 is expected to have negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In high inflation regime conditions (CPIAUCSL > 207.5 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
